```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
res_base_dir <- file.path("..", "02-Analyses", "results", "03-RF-LODO-PD-vs-Control", params$biobakery_tool)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

## Auroc vs 

# AUROC vs gradient

```{r load rf gradient results}
rf_predictions_gradients <- read_tsv(file.path(res_base_dir, "sample-size-gradient", "sample_size_gradient_res_ranger_relative_abundance.tsv")) %>% 
  mutate(wallen_in_training = grepl("Wallen", trainingDatasets))
```

```{r}
sample_gradient.gg <- ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = rf_predictions_gradients, mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC, color = factor(nTrainingDatasets))) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC, ymin = AUROC_lowerCI , ymax = AUROC_upperCI), color = "red2") + 
  geom_point(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC), color = "red2", size = 2) + 
  geom_label(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = 0.5, label = sprintf("%.3f", AUROC)), color = "red2") + 
  facet_wrap(~testDataset) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(direction = -1) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of samples in the training set", 
    color = "Number of training datasets"
  )

sample_gradient.gg
```

```{r}
sample_gradient_color_Wallen_in_training.gg <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = rf_predictions_gradients, mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC, color = wallen_in_training)) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC, ymin = AUROC_lowerCI , ymax = AUROC_upperCI), color = "red2") + 
  geom_point(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples, y = AUROC), color = "red2", size = 2) + 
  geom_label(data = rf_predictions_gradients %>% filter(nTrainingDatasets == 8), mapping = aes(x = nTrainingSamples - 100, y = 0.5, label = sprintf("%.3f", AUROC)), color = "red2") + 
  facet_wrap(~testDataset) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "gray80")) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, angle = 60)) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Number of samples in the training set", 
    color = "WallenZD_2022 in Training Set"
  )

ggsave(plot = sample_gradient_color_Wallen_in_training.gg, filename = file.path("results", "03-rf-with-sample-gradients.svg"), height = 8, width = 8)
```
